info.name: Ecommerce Store API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for all endpoints of the Ecommerce Web App Backend.

Includes:
- Authentication (Local & JWT)
- User Profile & Address Management
- Public Catalogue (Categories & Products)
- Cart, Checkout & Orders
- Payment (KHQR Bakong & status polling)
- Full Admin Dashboard & CRUD Management

item.name: 01b. Social Login - Facebook & Google (OAuth2)
item.description:
Facebook and Google OAuth2 login flow.

⚠️ OAuth2 requires a real browser - cannot be sent as a raw HTTP request.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Open Chrome → http://localhost:8080/test-register.html
2. Click 'Continue with Facebook' or 'Continue with Google'
3. Authorize the app in Facebook/Google
4. After success, browser redirects to:
   http://localhost:5173/oauth2/callback?accessToken=XXX&refreshToken=YYY
5. Copy accessToken from the URL
6. Use request #2 below to save it to {{accessToken}}
7. Use request #3 to verify the login worked

Facebook App ID: 959425077202957
Redirect URI: http://localhost:8080/login/oauth2/code/facebook

request.description:
⚠️ Open this URL in Chrome, NOT in Postman:
http://localhost:8080/oauth2/authorization/facebook

Flow:
1. Redirects to Facebook login
2. User authorizes the app
3. Spring Boot creates account (provider=FACEBOOK, emailVerified=true automatically)
4. Redirects to: http://localhost:5173/oauth2/callback?accessToken=...&refreshToken=...

Copy the accessToken from the URL → paste into request #2.

⚠️ Open this URL in Chrome, NOT in Postman:
http://localhost:8080/oauth2/authorization/google

Same flow as Facebook but uses Google account.

request.description:
📋 HOW TO USE:
1. Replace 'PASTE_YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN_HERE' in Authorization → Bearer Token with the token from browser URL
2. Also paste it in the body so the Pre-request Script saves it to {{accessToken}}
3. Send the request
4. Response will confirm your Facebook/Google user details

Uses the saved {{accessToken}} to verify the Facebook/Google login.

Expected response:
- provider: 'FACEBOOK' or 'GOOGLE'
- emailVerified: true
- fullName: from Facebook/Google profile
- profileImage: Facebook/Google profile picture URL
